title: Study of the Anti-Inflammatory Mechanism of beta-Carotene Based on Network Pharmacology.
authors: Wu, Shilin; Chen, Ran; Chen, Jingyun; Yang, Ning; Li, Kun; Zhang, Zhen; Zhang, Rongqing
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学研究β-胡萝卜素的抗炎机制，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物-疾病靶点网络，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: beta-carotene is known to have pharmacological effects such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-tumor properties. However, its main mechanism and related signaling pathways in the treatment of inflammation are still unclear. In this study, component target prediction was performed by using literature retrieval and the SwissTargetPrediction database. Disease targets were collected from various databases, including DisGeNET, OMIM, Drug Bank, and GeneCards. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed, and enrichment analysis of gene ontology and biological pathways was carried out for important targets. The analysis showed that there were 191 unique targets of beta-carotene after removing repeat sites. A total of 2067 targets from the three databases were integrated, 58 duplicate targets were removed, and 2009 potential disease action targets were obtained. Biological function enrichment analysis revealed 284 biological process (BP) entries, 31 cellular component (CC) entries, 55 molecular function (MF) entries, and 84 cellular pathways. The biological processes were mostly associated with various pathways and their regulation, whereas the cell components were mainly membrane components. The main molecular functions included RNA polymerase II transcription factor activity, DNA binding specific to the ligand activation sequence, DNA binding, steroid binding sequence-specific DNA binding, enzyme binding, and steroid hormone receptors. The pathways involved in the process included the TNF signaling pathway, sphingomyelin signaling pathway, and some disease pathways. Lastly, the anti-inflammatory signaling pathway of beta-carotene was systematically analyzed using network pharmacology, while the molecular mechanism of beta-carotene was further explored by molecular docking. In this study, the anti-inflammatory mechanism of beta-carotene was preliminarily explored and predicted by bioinformatics methods, and further experiments will be designed to verify and confirm the predicted results, in order to finally reveal the anti-inflammatory mechanism of beta-carotene.
abstract_zh: β-胡萝卜素已知具有抗炎、抗氧化和抗肿瘤等药理作用。然而，其在治疗炎症中的主要机制及相关信号通路仍不清楚。本研究通过文献检索和SwissTargetPrediction数据库进行成分靶点预测。疾病靶点从多个数据库收集，包括DisGeNET、OMIM、Drug Bank和GeneCards。构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并对重要靶点进行了基因本体论和生物通路富集分析。分析显示，去除重复位点后，β-胡萝卜素共有191个独特靶点。从三个数据库整合了共2067个靶点，去除58个重复靶点，获得2009个潜在疾病作用靶点。生物功能富集分析揭示了284个生物过程（BP）条目、31个细胞组分（CC）条目、55个分子功能（MF）条目和84条细胞通路。生物过程主要与各种通路及其调控相关，而细胞组分主要为膜组分。主要分子功能包括RNA聚合酶II转录因子活性、配体激活序列特异性DNA结合、DNA结合、类固醇结合序列特异性DNA结合、酶结合和类固醇激素受体。涉及的途径包括TNF信号通路、鞘磷脂信号通路及一些疾病通路。最后，利用网络药理学系统分析了β-胡萝卜素的抗炎信号通路，同时通过分子对接进一步探讨了β-胡萝卜素的分子机制。本研究通过生物信息学方法初步探索和预测了β-胡萝卜素的抗炎机制，并将设计进一步实验以验证和确认预测结果，最终揭示β-胡萝卜素的抗炎机制。
